Command `cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/ofp_print_target.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":11,"var":"data/size","code":"if (size < sizeof(struct ofp_header)) return 0;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are accepted as an OpenFlow message only when they are at least a header long."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/ofp_print_target.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"b","code":"ofpbuf_use_const(&b, data, size);","note":"The raw input buffer is wrapped without copying, so later parsing reads directly from attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/ofp_print_target.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":27,"var":"oh->length","code":"length = ntohs(oh->length);","note":"The OpenFlow header length field controls how many bytes the parser will treat as one message."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/ofp_print_target.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":33,"var":"length","code":"ofp_print(stdout, ofpbuf_pull(&b, length), length, NULL, NULL, 2);","note":"The selected message slice is handed to the OpenFlow printer, which dispatches into port-stats decoding."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"ofputil_decode_port_stats","line":1698,"var":"raw","code":"error = (msg->header ? ofpraw_decode(&raw, msg->header) : ofpraw_pull(&raw, msg));","note":"The printer identifies the message as an OFPST port-stats reply and routes it to the port-stats parser."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"ofputil_pull_ofp14_port_stats","line":1680,"var":"properties","code":"struct ofpbuf properties = ofpbuf_const_initializer(ofpbuf_pull(msg, len), len);","note":"The remaining bytes after the fixed port-stats header are treated as a property list, still fully attacker-controlled."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"ofputil_pull_ofp14_port_stats","line":1684,"var":"type/payload","code":"error = ofpprop_pull(&properties, &payload, &type);","note":"Each property is extracted from the attacker-supplied property blob and dispatched by type."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"parse_intel_port_custom_property","line":1604,"var":"custom_stats->stats_array_size","code":"ops->custom_stats.size = ntohs(custom_stats->stats_array_size);","note":"The Intel custom-property header supplies the number of counters to allocate and iterate over."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"parse_intel_port_custom_property","line":1606,"var":"ops->custom_stats.counters","code":"ops->custom_stats.counters = xcalloc(ops->custom_stats.size, sizeof *ops->custom_stats.counters);","note":"Memory is allocated for the attacker-chosen counter count, enabling later indexed reads from the property payload."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"parse_intel_port_custom_property","line":1614,"var":"current","code":"string_size = *current;","note":"The parser reads the counter-name length byte from the payload without first proving that the full counter record is present."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"parse_intel_port_custom_property","line":1624,"var":"current + string_size","code":"memcpy(&counter_value, current + string_size, value_size);","note":"The counter value is copied from an offset derived from the attacker-controlled name length, so an oversized or truncated record can make this read run past the property buffer."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src-vul/openvswitch/lib/ofp-port.c","function":"parse_intel_port_custom_property","line":1627,"var":"c->value","code":"c->value = ntohll(counter_value);","note":"The out-of-bounds bytes are interpreted as a 64-bit statistic, completing the buffer overread in the Intel custom statistics parser."}
]
